newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-O'Connor selected for Indian cricket tour.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-O'Connor selected for Indian cricket tour.

text.p: WELLINGTON, May 2 - Otago left armer Shayne O'Connor was on Friday called into the New Zealand squad for the one-day Independence Cup cricket tournament in India this month.
NZPA reports O'Connor, who hasn't played for New Zealand before, replaces the injured Simon Doull in the 14-strong squad.
Doull was forced out of the tour by a stress fracture in his back.
The 23-year-old O'Connor joins Heath Davis and Andrew Penn as New Zealand's three-pronged fast-medium attack for the tournament.
New Zealand will play Pakistan next Friday, India on May 14 and world champions Sri Lanka on May 20 in the round robin tournament.
The top two teams will then play a best-of-three finals series.
